attributes.board_name: Alabama State Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved seminars (e.g. AVMA, AAHA, AAVSB CE Taskforce, state associations, academies, veterinary schools); online only via RACE-approved courses; min. 16 h scientific, max. 4 h practice management
rules.new_licensee_rule: New graduates do not have to comply until the next full calendar year after licensure.
rules.alternatives: At the Board's discretion, non-practicing veterinarians over 70 may be exempted; extensions for sickness or other justifiable reasons on written request before renewal.
rules.audit_note: CE audits for practicing veterinarians are done at the time of premises evaluation; keep proof of attendance.
rules.notes: Licenses expire December 31 every year. Up to 10 of the 20 hours may be earned online, and only through RACE-approved courses. Licensees certify hours on a Board form at annual renewal.
rules.legal_basis: Ala. Admin. Code r. 930-X-1-.12; Code of Ala. 1975, §34-29-75
